name: Runtime Engineer
summary: Keeps the execution host fail-closed when policy configuration is empty or malformed.
description: Owns runtime safety around capability invocation. Uses core.authorize empty_or_invalid_policy denials so a missing rules array cannot open access.

distinguished_from.how: Owns host/runtime precondition failure behavior, not ordinary application policy authoring.
Hardens steady-state invalid-config paths; does not operate emergency break-glass access.
